case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Participants (n = 14) were operators who prepare chemotherapy.
object_definition: Pharmacy staff responsible for daily chemotherapy preparation using the robot.

evidence_statement: Operators with best ICT scores (min=9, max=12, mean=10.22) were designated as trainers.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: The trainer was a pharmacist who specialized in using the robot.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot

object_definition: A non-digital, instructor-led method based on reading, demonstration, and repetition.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: We created a short, playful, standardized, game-based training program to address this, and evaluated its impact.
object_definition: The overall new training intervention comprising preparatory work, introduction, three games, practical Peyton-based session, and debriefing.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot

evidence_statement: As the number of preparations increases, difficulties maintaining adequate numbers of appropriately trained staff may appear.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: We decided to create a short, standardized, sustainable operator training program.
object_definition: Internal requirement for a uniform training method to reduce disparities.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Training took place during the afternoon with teams of trainer/trainee constituted according to the work schedule of the unit.
object_definition: The need to fit 2-hour sessions into operators' daily work schedules.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: This was possible as the work was performed as part of a PhD thesis, with the doctoral student involved in 100% of the project.
object_definition: Availability of dedicated research time (over 100 hours) for developing the training.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: The standards of quality expected in Good Manufacturing Practices must be ensured when preparing cytotoxic drugs in cleanrooms.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: One team at a time entered the cleanroom with the training pharmacist.
object_definition: Physical controlled environment where chemotherapy is prepared.

evidence_statement: The repetitiveness and awkward postures associated with chemotherapy preparation within an isolator put operators at risk of musculoskeletal disorders.

evidence_statement: Our PharmaHelp robot was little used during the six months post-training because of a breakdown.

evidence_statement: Complex technical use, downtime periods, and insufficient training caused a drop in motivation and disparities in operators knowledge.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Operator hiring and departures gradually led to disparities in their training and knowledge.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Complex technical use and periods of machine downtime caused drops in motivation.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot

evidence_statement: Periods of machine downtime caused drops in motivation.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Motivation and self-efficacy decreased at six months (p>0.1 compared to pretraining). The decrease suggests regular refresher sessions are necessary.

evidence_statement: The present study's limitations include its small sample size (14 operators).

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: The low number of questions (10) used to survey their knowledge.
